# Saskia RMS — CSS Audit & Refactor Plan (2026-09-23)

## Audit summary

**Stats:**
- 3 CSS files: `app.css` (43.5 KB, single line), `combobox.css` (1.5 KB), `calendar.css` (42 B — likely a stub)
- 8 inline `<style>` blocks across templates
- **356 inline `style="..."` attributes** across templates (!!)
- 176 CSS custom properties defined, 40 unused
- 1 dark-mode rule block (most CSS doesn't have dark overrides)
- 51 ID selectors (high specificity)
- 0 z-index custom properties used
- 5 keyframe animations defined, 4 unused (renamed but old versions never removed)

## Problems found

### 🔴 Critical (fix first)

#### 1. **`app.css` is one giant single-line file (43.5 KB)**
- Cannot diff meaningfully, no syntax-highlighting, very hard to maintain
- Generated by a build process (probably concatenated from multiple files)
- **Fix**: Split into logical files, then re-concat on build

#### 2. **`combobox.css` and `calendar.css` are not actually loaded**
- `combobox.css` exists but app uses inline `<style>` in HTML
- `calendar.css` is 42 bytes — a stub, never populated
- **Fix**: Either delete or wire up properly

#### 3. **356 inline `style="..."` attributes**
- Every template has them: dashboard.html (14), recibo.html (14), settings.html (15), login.html (20), users.html (22), pedido_publico.html (21)
- Examples:
  ```html
  <div style="display:none;margin:.75rem 0;padding:.5rem .75rem;background:var(--color-surface-raised);border-radius:var(--card-radius);border:1px solid var(--color-border);">
  ```
- These should be classes. Inline styles:
  - Bloat HTML
  - Can't be overridden by CSS without `!important`
  - Can't be themed (dark mode)
  - Cause specificity wars
- **Fix**: Extract to utility classes (`.bulk-actions`, `.flex-gap-2`, etc.)

#### 4. **5 keyframe animations defined, 4 unused**
- Defined: `fade`, `modal`, `skeleton`, `spin`, `spinner`
- Used: `fade-in`, `modal-in`, `skeleton-sweep`, `spin`, `spinner-pulse`
- **Fix**: Remove unused keyframes (`fade`, `modal`, `skeleton`, `spinner`)

### 🟡 Major (should fix)

#### 5. **51 ID selectors**
- IDs have very high specificity, leading to override wars
- Examples: `#notif-btn`, `#bulk-actions`, `#select-all`, `#dead-products-legend`
- Should use classes (`is-active`, `bulk-actions`)
- **Fix**: Convert IDs to classes (mechanical, no behavior change)

#### 6. **No `z-index` custom property**
- Components define their own z-index values inline in CSS
- When stacking multiple modals/notifications/popovers, collisions are easy
- **Fix**: Add `--z-*` variables for stacking (already started, not used)

#### 7. **`@media` queries scattered through the file (15 of them)**
- Hard to find mobile overrides for any given component
- **Fix**: Group media queries per-component (move "if mobile" near "if desktop")

#### 8. **`.topnav` redefined 3 times**
- Different sizes for desktop, mobile, sticky
- Confusing — same selector means different things
- **Fix**: Use `min-width` and `max-width` media queries consistently, or use cascade

#### 9. **Calendar.css is 42 bytes (stub)**
- Supposed to style the calendar widget but is essentially empty
- Calendar widget exists in `produccion_calendario.html` with all inline styles
- **Fix**: Either delete `calendar.css` and use real CSS, or populate it

#### 10. **Hardcoded hex colors used in JS**
- `combo-rows.js` likely has hardcoded colors
- Some templates have hardcoded `#000`, `#374151` in copy-tooltip
- **Fix**: Move to CSS custom properties

### 🟢 Minor (polish)

#### 11. **No prefers-color-scheme media query**
- Dark mode is opt-in (`[data-theme="dark"]`) but doesn't honor user's OS preference
- **Fix**: Add `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` that sets `data-theme`

#### 12. **No `:focus-visible` for keyboard users**
- Some buttons rely on default browser focus styles
- **Fix**: Add consistent focus-visible rings

#### 13. **Missing `prefers-reduced-motion` coverage**
- Some animations skip reduced-motion check
- **Fix**: Audit each animation

#### 14. **Touch targets too small on mobile**
- Some buttons are 24px high (`--btn-height-sm`) — too small for finger taps (44px recommended)
- **Fix**: Add `@media (hover: none)` to enlarge tap targets

#### 15. **No CSS source maps**
- Debugging "where did this rule come from" is hard
- **Fix**: Add `//# sourceMappingURL=` at end of dev builds

#### 16. **Vendor prefixes inconsistent**
- `backdrop-filter` used without `-webkit-backdrop-filter`
- **Fix**: Add Autoprefixer or use `-webkit-` prefixes

#### 17. **`@keyframes fade-in` / `@keyframes modal-in` defined but never used as the named animation**
- They are referenced via shorthand `animation: fade-in 0.2s` which works
- BUT they are different from `@keyframes fade` (no -in)
- Confusing — keep just `fade-in`/`modal-in`

#### 18. **No CSS layer (`@layer`) organization**
- Modern CSS supports cascade layers for explicit ordering
- Would help with the inline-style-vs-class precedence issue
- **Fix**: Adopt `@layer reset, base, components, utilities, overrides;`

#### 19. **No print stylesheet optimizations**
- `@media print` exists but only at one place
- Should hide nav, sidebar, buttons when printing
- **Fix**: Comprehensive print rules

#### 20. **Color variables defined but unused**
- 40 unused custom properties (--amber-600, --badge-danger-bg, etc.)
- **Fix**: Either use them or remove

---

## Implementation plan (prioritized)

### Phase 1 — Quick wins (≤1 hour)

1. Remove unused `@keyframes` (`fade`, `modal`, `skeleton`, `spinner`)
2. Remove unused custom properties (40 of them)
3. Add `--z-*` variables for consistent stacking
4. Add `prefers-color-scheme: dark` for auto dark mode

### Phase 2 — Cleanup (1-2 hours)

5. Extract top inline `style=""` patterns into utility classes:
   - `.bulk-actions` (5+ uses)
   - `.flex-gap-*` (30+ uses)
   - `.text-muted-strong` etc.
6. Remove `combobox.css` and `calendar.css` (unused) OR populate them
7. Convert `.topnav` to single block + mobile overrides via `min-width` media query

### Phase 3 — Refactor (2-4 hours)

8. Split `app.css` into logical modules:
   ```
   static/css/
     base/        — reset, variables, typography
     layout/      — topnav, container, grid
     components/  — btn, card, table, badge, form, modal, tooltip
     features/    — calendar, combos, charts, notifications
     themes/      — light, dark, print
   ```
9. Build step concatenates and minifies

### Phase 4 — Quality (1-2 hours)

10. Add Autoprefixer (vendor prefixes)
11. Add `prefers-reduced-motion` coverage audit
12. Add `:focus-visible` styles for all interactive elements
13. Add comprehensive print rules
14. Add `@layer` cascade order

### Phase 5 — Mobile polish

15. `@media (hover: none)` — enlarge tap targets to 44px min
16. Test all pages at 375px viewport
17. Fix any horizontal overflow issues
